message: Hey Jane, I'm really looking forward to the Crestview Cares event. It's a great way for us to give back to the community.
Jane, I've been crunching numbers for the EcoPure campaign. The results are beyond our expectations! Can't wait to share at the next meeting.
I'm glad we're doing the Crestview Cares event. It's been a tough month with the surgery I had for my knee injury, but focusing on work and helping others is keeping me positive.
